title_sq: Ne Astir Buze Rruges Kryesore, Shitet Njesi Biznesi, Ideale Per Investim!!
description_sq: Ne Astir, buze rruges kryesore shitet ambient biznesi ideal per investim. Prona ndodhet ne katin 1 banim, si dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto prej 158,62 m2, nga ku siperfaqja neto eshte 126,7 m2. Ambienti organizohet nga nje open space, nje dhome dhe nje tualet. Fasada e xhamit qe rrethon ambientin eshte ideale per reklamim, prona ndodhet ne nje pallat te ri, te mireorganizuar. Aktualisht ne kete njesi biznesi eshte nje qender estetike, por mund te zhvillohen veprimtari te ndryshme biznesi si: klinike dentare, zyra, bar etj.
title_en: In Astir, on the edge of the main road, a business unit for sale, ideal for investment!!
description_en: In Astir, on the edge of the main road, an ideal business environment for investment is for sale. The property is located on the 1st residential floor and has a gross area of ​​158.62 m2, from which the net area is 126.7 m2. The environment is organized by an open space, a room and a toilet. The glass facade that surrounds the environment is ideal for advertising, the property is located in a new, well-organized building. Currently, this business unit is an aesthetic center, but different business activities can be developed such as: dental clinic, office, bar, etc.
